synthetic_long_video_128.description: Scaled 128-frame RGB-D benchmark for Video Depth Anything. Paper reference values are from the VDA-S inference-strategy ablation in Table 5; reproduced scores are computed on the local synthetic benchmark.

temporal_gradient_error.description: Mean selected-frame temporal gradient mismatch against RGB-D ground truth; lower values indicate steadier video depth.

boundary_temporal_error.description: Temporal gradient mismatch on held-out 32-frame window boundaries, catching stitching shortcuts that look smooth inside windows.

absrel.description: Absolute relative depth error after one global inverse-depth affine alignment.

scale_drift_error.description: Change in median log depth bias between early and late selected frames, penalizing long-video scale drift.

delta1.description: Fraction of aligned depth pixels within a 1.25 relative-error threshold.

param_count_M.description: Model parameter count in millions, included as a resource constraint.

video_training_frames_M.description: Video depth training frames in millions, included as a data-budget constraint.
